targetWords.definition: Advice is an opinion about what to do.
targetWords.example: I don't know how to study for my exams. Can you give me some advicel

targetWords.definition: Along means to move from one part of a road, river, etc. to another.
targetWords.example: Walk along this tunnel for ten minutes, and you'll see a door on the left.

targetWords.definition: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.
targetWords.example: His work got the attention of two of his co-workers.

targetWords.definition: To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be intereste
To climb means to use your hands and feet to go up on something.
targetWords.example: ■The girls climbed to the top of the mountain.

targetWords.definition: To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.
targetWords.example: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.

targetWords.definition: If something is final, it is the last part.
targetWords.example: In the final part of the film, the man and the woman got married.

targetWords.definition: Further is used to say something is from a distance or time.
targetWords.example: The escalator is further along than I thought.

targetWords.definition: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.
targetWords.example: ■The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn't say so.

targetWords.definition: The balls maintain constant movement.
You use neither to connect two negative statements.
targetWords.example: Neither the pass on the left nor the pass on the right will lead us home.

targetWords.definition: Otherwise means different or in another way.
targetWords.example: It's good to stay active; otherwise, you'll gain weight.

targetWords.definition: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.
targetWords.example: Biking is good for your physical health.

targetWords.definition: To prove something is to show that it is true.
targetWords.example: My teacher proved the answer on the board.

targetWords.definition: To react is to act in a certain way because of something that happened.
You can ride an animal, a bike, etc.
targetWords.example: I will ride a roller-coaster for the first time today.

targetWords.definition: If something is situated somewhere, it is in that place.
targetWords.example: The white board is situated between the two men.

targetWords.definition: Society is people and the way that they live.
targetWords.example: Society expects people to be good and honest.

targetWords.definition: A standard is what people consider normal or good.
targetWords.example: This older model TV is below our store's standards.

targetWords.definition: To suggest something means to give an idea or plan about it.
targetWords.example: He suggested that we go to see his boss. 159

story.title: Archie and His Donkey
story.passage:
Old Archie needed some money. He decided to sell his donkey. So he and his

son Tom went to town. It was situated many miles away.

Soon, they met a woman. "Where are you going?" she asked.

"To town," said Archie.

"Any smart person would ride the donkey," she said.

"What are you implying?" Archie asked. " I'm very smart!" Archie wanted to

look smart. So he climbed onto the donkey. Then they continued in the direction

of the town.

Further along the road, they met a farmer.

" Hello," said Archie. "We want to sell this donkey. Do you want to buy it?"

" I don't need a donkey," said the farmer. " But if you want my advice, don't ride

it. The donkey needs to be in good physical condition."

" Good idea," said Archie. "Tom, I want you to ride it. You're lighter."

" Neither you nor your son should ride it. It looks very tired. You should carry

the donkey." suggested the farmer.

"You're right," said Archie. "Come on, Tom! We'll carry it for the final few miles!"

The donkey was very heavy, and they couldn't maintain a good speed. They

didn't arrive until late in the evening. At last, they walked into the town. But there

they attracted the attention of some teenage boys. They laughed at Tom and

Archie. They started to throw stones at them. The donkey reacted by kicking. Tom

and Archie dropped the donkey. It fell on the ground and then ran

away. Archie lost his donkey. He went home with no money.

What does this story teach us? We cannot please

everyone in our society. Don't take

everyone's advice, but set your

own standards. Prove to everyone

can make decisions by

at all.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this story?

options.text: You should always take the advice of older people.
Teenage boys are the nicest people in society.
You should set your own standards.
You should neither ride nor carry a donkey.

questions.question: Why did Archie get on the donkey?

options.text: The woman implied that he wasn't smart.
The town was situated further away than he had thought.
He did not want to climb the final hill.
His walking speed was too slow.

questions.question: Why did the farmer suggest carrying the donkey?

options.text: To keep the donkey in good physical condition
To prove that Archie was strong

questions.question: Why did the donkey start kicking?

options.text: It didn't want to be carried along the road.
It didn't want to go in the direction of the river.
It reacted badly to a group of teenage boys' teasing.
It became very angry at Archie and Tom.
